//: Copy this file to appsettings.Production.json ON THE SERVER and fill in real values.
//_never_commit: appsettings.Production.json is git-ignored and is never copied by dotnet publish, so your server values survive deploys.
//_overrides: Anything set here overrides appsettings.json. Keys you leave out fall back to the committed defaults.

ConnectionStrings.//: SQL Server the API connects to. Migrations are applied automatically at startup.

AuthSettings.//_Key: REQUIRED. Secret used to sign login tokens. Must be long and random - anyone who knows it can forge a login as any user. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

ReverseProxy.//: CIDR ranges of the proxy in front of the API (e.g. Cloudflare's IPv4/IPv6 ranges from cloudflare.com/ips). Only these may set the client address in X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty when IIS faces the internet directly.

Cors.//: Browser origins allowed to call this API. Must be the exact scheme+host of the deployed frontend, no trailing slash.

Xero.//: The one app registered at developer.xero.com (My Apps > the app > Configuration). There is no sandbox/production split and customers never bring their own credentials.
Xero.//_credentials: REQUIRED. Client id and client secret of the Xero app. The API refuses to start without them.
Xero.//_RedirectUri: REQUIRED. Must match a redirect URI registered on the Xero app EXACTLY - scheme, host, path. This is a frontend route, not an API route.
Xero.//_Scope: Leave out to use the committed default. If you add a scope, raise ScopeVersion so existing connections are asked to re-authorise.
Xero.//_Webhooks: WebhookCallbackBaseUrl is the public https origin Xero reaches this API on; the delivery URL to register is <base><PathBase>/api/xero/webhooks. WebhookKey is shown by the Xero developer portal once the webhook is saved - without it every delivery is answered 401 and Xero will not enable the webhook.

Sync.//: The backstop behind webhooks: lists documents modified since the last run. On by default.

Fiscalize.//: The Fiscalize platform this service fiscalises through.

AppMail.//: Outbound mail. Leave blank to disable email.

//_PathBase: Set to the subpath the API is served under, or "" if it is at a domain root.
